Senior Backend Systems Engineer
Acme Corporation is looking for a senior backend engineer to join our core infrastructure team.
Responsibilities:
- Design, scale, and maintain high-throughput streaming systems in Node.js and TypeScript.
- Ensure fault-tolerance and write comprehensive integration test suites.
Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with distributed systems in production.
- Deep understanding of database indexing, query optimization, and connection pooling.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technical architecture discussions.

Staff Frontend Architect
TechCorp is seeking a frontend architect to drive our design system.
Responsibilities:
- Architect accessible, high-performance web applications using React and Next.js.
- Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and platform engineers.
Requirements:
- 6+ years of modern JavaScript and TypeScript development.
- Deep expertise in web performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.
- Proven track record establishing architectural guidelines for engineering teams.

Junior Full Stack Developer
Basic knowledge of Python and JavaScript required.

Principal Data Engineer
Global Data Systems seeks an experienced data pipeline engineer.
Responsibilities:
- Build real-time streaming architectures using Kafka and Spark.
Requirements:
- 5+ years building production ETL data pipelines.
- Experience with columnar data stores and schema registries.

Senior Site Reliability Engineer
CloudScale seeks an SRE to manage our multi-region Kubernetes clusters.
Responsibilities:
- Manage Kubernetes clusters, Terraform infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Lead incident post-mortems and automate toil.
Requirements:
- 4+ years running high-availability cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP.
- Production experience with Kubernetes, Prometheus, and infrastructure-as-code.
